_note: The IEEE 802.15.4 energy scanner (github.com/joakimeriksson/esp32 energy_scan) on the Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47: LVGL on the ST7789 over SPI2+GDMA, WS2812 on RMT, energy detect from the emulated 802.15.4 MAC. bb_init is the PHY blob's baseband calibration, which needs hardware handshakes the model does not have; the MAC model does not depend on it. Copy the build products into local/ (git-ignored).
